A.narrative: Late completed shipments were unchanged at 70 versus the previous closed interval (0). The accounting decomposition shows north +20 and south -20, but the workflow’s required warehouse-contribution evidence is unresolved, so this result is blocked despite the available numeric comparison. Contributions do not establish causality. No notification is issued under the authoritative workflow outcome. The selected export otherwise appears explicit, complete, and reconciled; the evidence workflow should resolve the missing watch:2 determination before relying on this period.

B.narrative: Total late completed shipments were unchanged at 70, but warehouse contributions crossed the policy threshold: north increased by 20 while south decreased by 20. Notify Fulfillment because a warehouse contributed at least 15, even though the net change was zero. The export is complete, reconciled, fresh, and explicitly defined. The decomposition identifies measured warehouse movements, not their causes; Fulfillment should review the north/south shift.
